detail.longDescription: A Truffle Security investigation discovered over 9,300 active, publicly exposed AWS access keys, with 768 granting full administrative control. Hugging Face was identified as the primary source, with 88% of exposed credentials remaining unrotated for a median of five years, leading to significant unauthorized spending and lack of budget alerts. Read the full analysis at Truffle Security. https://www. scworld.com/brief/thousands-of -active-aws-access-keys-remain-publicly-exposed # CyberSecurity # CloudSecurity # AWS # DevOps # InfoSec # DataBreach # AppSec # CloudComputing # TechNews
